turns.question: How many monthly active customers did we have on 3 October 2026?
turns.answer: Engaged customers (28 days), meaning customers with any site or CRM action in the 28 days ending 3 October 2026, numbered 10 (this is not the count of customers with a non-cancelled order). Late: customer_actions.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
